assess_tensorizer_node: assess a BMG node to determine if it can be tensorized using Tensorizer.assess_node
transform_tensorizer_node: transform a BMG node into a matrix-aware BMG node using Tensorizer.transform_node
check_can_be_tensorized: check if a BMG node can be tensorized using Tensorizer.can_be_tensorized
tensorize_multiply: tensorize a multiplication node into elementwise or matrix scale using Tensorizer._tensorize_multiply
determine_element_type: determine the element type of a BMG node as SCALAR, MATRIX, TENSOR, or UNKNOWN using Tensorizer._element_type
